parameters.query:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.location, a.starts_at, a.ends_at, a.reminder_sent, a.conversation_id, c.display_name, c.phone, c.email, c.id as contact_id, c.business_id, b.waha_session_name, b.timezone AS business_timezone
  FROM appointments a
  JOIN contacts c ON a.contact_id = c.id
  JOIN businesses b ON b.id = c.business_id
 WHERE a.status IN ('scheduled', 'confirmed')
   AND a.starts_at > NOW()
   AND a.starts_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours'
   AND COALESCE(a.metadata #>> ARRAY['reminders',
        CASE
          WHEN a.starts_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours' THEN '2h'
          WHEN a.starts_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours' THEN '24h'
          ELSE '48h'
        END], '') = ''
 ORDER BY a.starts_at ASC
 LIMIT 20;

WITH msg AS (
  INSERT INTO messages (conversation_id, direction, sender_type, message_type, text_body, metadata, business_id, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT NULLIF($1, '')::uuid, 'outgoing', 'staff', 'text', $2, $3,
         COALESCE((SELECT business_id FROM conversations WHERE id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid),
                  (SELECT id FROM businesses LIMIT 1)),
         NOW(), NOW()
  RETURNING id
), marked AS (
  UPDATE appointments
     SET metadata = jsonb_set(COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb), '{reminders}',
           COALESCE(metadata->'reminders', '{}'::jsonb) ||
             jsonb_build_object($5::text, jsonb_build_object('status', 'sent', 'sent_at', NOW())), true),
         reminder_sent = TRUE,
         updated_at = NOW()
   WHERE id = NULLIF($4, '')::uuid
  RETURNING id
), audited AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_logs (entity_type, entity_id, action, performed_by, performed_by_type, description, new_values, metadata)
  SELECT 'appointment', NULLIF($4, '')::uuid, 'reminder_sent', NULL, 'system',
         'Automated ' || $5 || ' reminder sent for appointment: ' || $6,
         jsonb_build_object('reminder_type', $5),
         jsonb_build_object('appointment_title', $6, 'contact_id', NULLIF($7, '')::uuid, 'timestamp', NOW())
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT msg.id AS id, marked.id AS appointment_id, c.phone AS phone, b.waha_session_name AS waha_session_name,
       $2 AS message, $5 AS reminder_type
  FROM msg, marked, audited, conversations v, contacts c, businesses b
 WHERE v.id = NULLIF($1, '')::uuid AND c.id = v.contact_id AND b.id = c.business_id;
